inj.note: reporters the Denver Gazette, Waddle headed to the locker room Sunday after having absorbed a hard hit, leaving Courtland Sutton, Pat Bryant, Troy Franklin and Marvin Mims as the Broncos' available WRs. Prior to his exit, Waddle caught his only target for 22 yards.

news.h: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle, CB Riley Moss suffer concussions against Panthers
news.d: Broncos wide receiver Jaylen Waddle and cornerback Riley Moss both suffered concussions against the Panthers.
